title: MZ An FF-style (or 2003 style) Battle UI

posts.author: MechPen
posts.body:
FFBattleUI v0.0.1
by me, MechPen
​
Introduction
@utunnels
's project16mz inspired me to make something Final Fantasy 5 themed.
Features
Rearranges the battle UI windows to look similar to a popular SNES jRPG or RPG Maker 2003. Of note is the vertical style actor status window.
Screenshots
Spoiler:
A screenshot of battle
How to Use
Place in plugins folder, enable in Plugin List, set the Enemy Window Width depending on how long your enemy names are. Adjust Gauge Sprite Width and Name Sprite Width as needed.
Download
Right-click here and Save As...
Terms and Credits
MIT Licensed.
In Developement?
Yeah. I finished writing it and slapped it up here. It works for me but does it work with your favorite plugins? Non-standard icon sizes? Custom resolutions? Let me know if you have any issues.

posts.author: MikePjr
posts.body:
It seems to close at the end of a battle.
Is there any way to make it stay open?

posts.author: MechPen
posts.body: Probably! It closes because the default battle results are shown in a message and the battle UI is still programmed to close when a message is showing.
